provenance: New replacement concepts generated 2026-11-10 UTC / 11 November 2026 Australia/Melbourne, not recovered originals. Built-in image_gen, one call per image. Based on exact WF01–WF05 written specs at https://chatgpt.com/space/page_b16e2b88b61881918a4c8a18461a10f6 and recovered D01 Melbourne Terminal reference. All PNGs preserved byte-for-byte without resizing.
review: Visually reviewed all five outputs for visual continuity and required screen content. Illustrative content is not deployed functionality. Written interaction/source semantics govern implementation, not generated labels. Existing navigation must be preserved in implementation; these crops are visual explorations.
caveats: WF01: discussion entry and private-note control are separate product actions; the adjacent private-note strip must not imply a public question is private. An unavailable current check does not change the last successful check timestamp.
WF02: 'account and activity not shown' is overbroad. Public contributions remain public; private account identifiers and private activity stay private. WF05 states this more precisely.

WF03: observed omission means an omission in an inspected relevant field, not a guess based on expected or usual format. The heatmap/source-state arrangement explores layout, not a validated activity metric encoding. Equivalent table weighting must use actual published semantics.

WF04: an unavailable current source does not necessarily erase an archived prior version. Retention and cutoff semantics govern inclusion. Fixed available-by and observation boundaries must be applied consistently to every source.
WF05: reviewer controls and roles are proposed design exploration, not evidence permissions or publication workflows are implemented.

Across the set: fictitious Example Co/EXM, chart shapes, counts, source identifiers, and dates are illustrative. Generated navigation is not a specification to replace existing navigation. No release holds or publication contracts are changed.
